info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Compliance Management API
info.description: The Operational Compliance Management API facilitates the submission and management of operational actions related to legal compliance within enterprise banking services. This API allows financial institutions and regulatory personnel to initiate compliance-related processes efficiently and ensures adherence to legal standards. Typical consumers include compliance officers and risk management teams seeking to streamline their operational workflows. By providing a clear interface for tracking and managing actions, this API enhances governance and reduces compliance risks.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for legal compliance.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action that ensures adherence to legal compliance. It is designed for enterprises looking to manage their operational activities in line with legal standards and regulations. The implementation is straightforward and aims to facilitate seamless integration into existing workflows.
